ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left side of the figure is the AC voltage input terminal, marked with positive and negative terminals and voltage u; the circuit is connected from the upper terminal sequentially to resistor R and inductor L, then on the right to capacitor C and back to the bottom terminal. The three components are in the same closed branch, so it is a series RLC circuit. Reasoning: It is known that u = 200√2 sin(314t) V, so the maximum voltage value Um = 200√2 V, and the corresponding effective value U = Um/√2 = 200 V. In a series circuit, the reactance part of the total impedance is X = XL - XC = 9 - 3 = 6 Ω. The impedance magnitude |Z| = √(R² + X²) = √(8² + 6²) = √100 = 10 Ω. The effective value of the total current I = U/|Z| = 200/10 = 20 A.
